translations.web: For my eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from my face. Their iniquity isn’t concealed from my eyes.
translations.bsb: For My eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from My face, and their guilt is not concealed from My eyes.
translations.kjv: For mine eyes are upon all their ways: they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes.
translations.asv: For mine eyes are upon all their ways; they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity concealed from mine eyes.
